release_notes.headline_internal: /adv-cleanup covers four hygiene surfaces and can execute worktree and branch cleanup
highlights: Discovery now spans active-change debt, worktree drift, merged archived change/* branches, and archived/closed state leaks in a single run
Worktree and merged-branch deletion are executable in-command; state leaks stay report-only and route to adv_archive_purge
Irreversible buckets require count-matched typed confirmation and reject the reversible-bucket approve-all token; no LLM fallback on any reply
Destructive candidates are listed by exact path or branch name with reversibility marker, recovery path, and deleted SHA in the result line
Deletion delegates to adv_worktree_delete / adv_worktree_cleanup per rq-terminalCleanupSafety01; adv_worktree_triage output is explicitly advisory, never deletion authority
Added an OrphanClass to drift-group eligibility mapping so deletion is gated on categories adv_worktree_triage actually emits, with unrecognized classes failing closed
New spec law rq-cleanupHygieneScope01 with five scenarios; /adv-cleanup scope previously had no governing requirement
